# TMN Events

> Corporate event planning, in-house AV production, and destination management company in Boise, Idaho. TMN Events produces corporate events end to end — sales kickoffs, partner summits, incentive trips, annual meetings, and trade show activations — on four continents since 1998. In-house AV team and inventory (no third-party AV markup), preferred DMC partner for Sun Valley Resorts, trusted by HP, Canon, Chobani, and Dairy West.

Key facts: founded 1998; based at 418 S 9th Street, Suite 208, Boise, Idaho; phone +1-208-385-9510; email cheers@tmnevents.com; twenty-one people producing events from twenty executives to twelve hundred guests.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://www.tmnevents.com/services): Six disciplines under one roof — event management, AV, DMC, event technology, experiential design, and event ROI measurement.
- [Full-Service Corporate Event Management](https://www.tmnevents.com/services/event-management): Planning, budgets, registration, run of show, and logistics for sales kickoffs, user conferences, and executive offsites.
- [In-House Corporate AV & Staging Production](https://www.tmnevents.com/services/corporate-av): Staging, lighting, LED walls, hybrid and live streaming — in-house engineers and inventory, no third-party AV markup.
- [Destination Management & Incentive Travel](https://www.tmnevents.com/services/destination-management): Venue sourcing, ground transportation, and activities for incentive trips, partner summits, and executive offsites.
- [Event Technology & Registration Management](https://www.tmnevents.com/services/event-technology): Custom event apps, registration websites, on-site check-in, and badging.
- [Experiential Event Design & Brand Activation](https://www.tmnevents.com/services/experiential-design): Immersive brand experiences, trade show activations, and scenic built by one in-house team.
- [Event Survey & ROI Measurement](https://www.tmnevents.com/services/surveys-data-roi): Pre-, in-, and post-event surveys, engagement data, and post-event reporting.
